title: Observability: successful provider dispatch logged only at pr_debug, invisible in production
description: In ioctl_init() (crypto2dev_fd.c lines 685-687), successful provider dispatch is logged with pr_debug(), which is compiled out by default and invisible in production kernels. When two providers register the same algo, first-registered wins silently. A support engineer asked which provider is handling cbc(aes) on this system cannot answer the question from kernel logs without enabling dynamic debug. The algo and provider are available in GET_STATE, but that requires an active session. A pr_info at dispatch time would make the selection visible post-hoc in dmesg.
